scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi, this is Ms. Carter from Harbor Trading.
scene.zh: 嗨，我是 Harbor Trading 的 Carter。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Do you have a moment? I have some good news.
scene.zh: 你現在方便講一下嗎？我有個好消息。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We all liked you, and we'd like to offer you the job.
scene.zh: 我們大家都很喜歡你，想請你來上班。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm so happy to hear that!
scene.zh: 聽到這個消息我好開心！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great! So can I tell everyone you accept?
scene.zh: 太好了！那我可以跟大家說你接受了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm looking forward to working with you.
scene.zh: 很期待跟您一起工作。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So are we. Everyone here is excited to meet you.
scene.zh: 我們也是。這裡大家都很期待見到你。

fills.en: We usually have lunch at ___ in the office.
fills.zh: 我們通常中午在辦公室吃午餐。
fills.note: at noon 是固定說法，at 不接 today。

fills.en: Ms. Carter always ___ at exactly eight.
fills.zh: Carter 女士總是八點整準時到。
fills.note: 主詞是她一個人，現在式動詞加 s：arrives。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, Monday is your first day with us.
scene.zh: 那麼，星期一是你來上班的第一天。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Which floor is your office on?
scene.zh: 你們辦公室在幾樓？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The third floor, right above a small bank.
scene.zh: 三樓，就在一家小銀行的樓上。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The elevator is in the lobby, on your right.
scene.zh: 電梯在大廳，在你的右手邊。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I wait for you in the lobby?
scene.zh: 我要在大廳等您嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, please. I can come down and meet you.
scene.zh: 好，麻煩你。我可以下樓去接你。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And then we can have lunch together at noon.
scene.zh: 然後中午我們可以一起吃午餐。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Can you come in a little early on Monday?
scene.zh: 星期一你可以早一點來嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sure, I'll be there by eight thirty.
scene.zh: 好，我八點半前會到。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. We have a team meeting at nine.
scene.zh: 很好。我們九點有團隊會議。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Don't worry, I won't be late.
scene.zh: 別擔心，我不會遲到的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I know. I'll send you your schedule soon.
scene.zh: 我知道。我很快會把你的行程表寄給你。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Please confirm when you receive it, okay?
scene.zh: 收到的時候請回覆確認一下，好嗎？

passages.title: Your First Day on Monday
lines: Welcome to Harbor Trading! Please arrive at 8:30.
Wait for me in the lobby on the first floor. We'll take the elevator up together.
Please bring your ID and your bank card.
Dress: casual. No suit or tie. A normal shirt or sweater is fine.

questions.en: What should you bring on Monday?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi, it's Ms. Carter again. Did you get my email?
scene.zh: 嗨，又是我，Carter。你收到我的信了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thanks, I just got your email.
scene.zh: 謝謝，我剛收到您的信。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. Do you have any questions about Monday?
scene.zh: 很好。關於星期一你有什麼問題嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do I need to wear a suit?
scene.zh: 我需要穿西裝嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No, you don't. We're pretty casual here. No suit, no tie.
scene.zh: 不用。我們這裡滿隨興的，不用西裝也不用領帶。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Just wear a normal shirt or a sweater instead.
scene.zh: 穿一般的襯衫或毛衣就可以了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We only dress up for formal meetings.
scene.zh: 我們只有正式會議才會穿得比較正式。

lines.en: These flowers are for you. Let's celebrate!
lines.zh: 這束花送你。我們來慶祝吧！

lines.en: They're beautiful! Thank you so much.
Come to dinner at our place on Saturday at six.
lines.zh: 星期六六點來我們家吃晚餐吧。

lines.en: I'd love to! What can I bring?
lines.zh: 好啊！我可以帶什麼過去？

lines.en: Nothing. My husband is going to cook your favorite food.
lines.zh: 什麼都不用帶。我先生要煮你最喜歡吃的菜。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! I was just walking by. How are you?
scene.zh: 嗨！我剛好經過。你最近好嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Guess what, I start work on Monday!
scene.zh: 你猜怎麼樣，我星期一就要開始上班了！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Really? You finally got a real office job!
scene.zh: 真的嗎？你終於找到真正的辦公室工作了！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'm so proud of you. We have to celebrate!
scene.zh: 我真替你驕傲。我們一定要慶祝一下！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: My family in Taiwan will be so happy.
scene.zh: 我在台灣的家人一定會很開心。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Of course! Will you go home for the holidays?
scene.zh: 那當然！你年底放假會回去嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Traffic is really bad in the morning, you know.
scene.zh: 你知道嗎，早上真的很塞。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm going to leave early to miss the traffic.
scene.zh: 我要早點出門，避開塞車。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good idea. Drive along Park Road toward the city.
scene.zh: 好主意。你就沿著 Park Road 往市區的方向開。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Harbor Trading is across the water from here.
scene.zh: Harbor Trading 在水的對岸。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So I have to go across the bridge?
scene.zh: 所以我要過那座橋？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, it's the fastest route. You'll pass the park.
scene.zh: 對，那是最快的路線。你會經過公園。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! I just came by. Big day tomorrow, right?
scene.zh: 嗨！我順道過來看看。明天是大日子，對吧？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Do you have all your stuff for tomorrow?
scene.zh: 明天要帶的東西都弄好了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Everything is ready for my first day.
scene.zh: 第一天要用的東西都準備好了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. I wonder what your new colleagues are like.
scene.zh: 太好了。不知道你的新同事是什麼樣的人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Anyway, tomorrow is the start of a new life!
scene.zh: 總之，明天就是新生活的開始了！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thanks for all your help since I moved here.
scene.zh: 謝謝你從我搬來以後幫了我這麼多。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You're welcome. Now set your clock and go to bed!
scene.zh: 不客氣。現在快去設好鬧鐘，然後上床睡覺！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi, it's Ms. Carter. Did you receive my email?
scene.zh: 嗨，我是 Carter。你收到我的信了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thanks, I just got your email.
scene.zh: 謝謝，我剛收到您的信。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. Do you have any questions about Monday?
scene.zh: 很好。關於星期一你有什麼問題嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I wait for you in the lobby?
scene.zh: 我要在大廳等您嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. Can you be there a little early?
scene.zh: 對。你可以早一點到嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sure, I'll be there by eight thirty.
scene.zh: 好，我八點半前會到。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Everyone is excited to meet you.
scene.zh: 太好了。大家都很期待見到你。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm looking forward to working with you.
scene.zh: 很期待跟您一起工作。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: See you on Monday, then. Have a good weekend!
scene.zh: 那就星期一見囉。週末愉快！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So? Who was that on the phone?
scene.zh: 怎麼樣？剛剛是誰打來的？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Guess what, I start work on Monday!
scene.zh: 你猜怎麼樣，我星期一就要開始上班了！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's great news! How are you getting there?
scene.zh: 真是好消息！你要怎麼去上班？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm going to leave early to miss the traffic.
scene.zh: 我要早點出門，避開塞車。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good idea. A new job and a new life!
scene.zh: 好主意。新工作、新生活！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thanks for all your help since I moved here.
scene.zh: 謝謝你從我搬來以後幫了我這麼多。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You're welcome! Promise to tell me all about your first day.
scene.zh: 不客氣啦！答應我，上班第一天的事都要跟我說喔。
